preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN to_regclass('public.hunttech_admin_ai_configuration') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.hunttech_ai_function_configuration') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HUNTTECH_ADMIN_AI_CONFIGURATION WHERE PROVIDER_CODE = 'deepseek' AND DELETE_TS IS NULL AND IS_ACTIVE = TRUE AND API_KEY_ENCRYPTED IS NOT NULL AND DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME IS NOT NULL

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HUNTTECH_AI_FUNCTION_CONFIGURATION f JOIN HUNTTECH_ADMIN_AI_CONFIGURATION a ON a.ID = f.ADMIN_CONFIGURATION_ID WHERE f.CODE = 'CANDIDATE_VACANCY_MATCH_ANALYZE' AND f.DELETE_TS IS NULL AND f.IS_ACTIVE = TRUE AND f.VERSION IS NOT NULL AND f.ADMIN_MODEL_NAME = 'nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free' AND a.PROVIDER_CODE = 'openrouter' AND a.DELETE_TS IS NULL) = 1 OR ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HUNTTECH_AI_FUNCTION_CONFIGURATION f JOIN HUNTTECH_ADMIN_AI_CONFIGURATION a ON a.ID = f.ADMIN_CONFIGURATION_ID WHERE f.CODE = 'CANDIDATE_VACANCY_MATCH_ANALYZE' AND f.DELETE_TS IS NULL AND f.IS_ACTIVE = TRUE AND f.VERSION IS NOT NULL AND f.ADMIN_MODEL_NAME = a.DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME AND a.PROVIDER_CODE = 'deepseek' AND a.DELETE_TS IS NULL AND a.IS_ACTIVE = TRUE AND a.API_KEY_ENCRYPTED IS NOT NULL) = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM HUNTTECH_AI_FUNCTION_CONFIGURATION f JOIN HUNTTECH_ADMIN_AI_CONFIGURATION a ON a.ID = f.ADMIN_CONFIGURATION_ID WHERE f.CODE = 'CANDIDATE_VACANCY_MATCH_ANALYZE' AND f.DELETE_TS IS NULL AND f.IS_ACTIVE = TRUE AND f.VERSION IS NOT NULL AND a.PROVIDER_CODE = 'openrouter' AND a.DELETE_TS IS NULL)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
